title: Mexico Does Not Have the Capacity to Confront the Cartels, Trump Says
author: La Redacción
content:
_This article by[La
Redacción](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/la%20redacci%C3%B3n) originally
appeared in the [October 15, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/15/mundo/mexico-no-tiene-
la-capacidad-para-enfrentar-a-los-carteles-trump), Mexico's premier left wing
daily newspaper._

US President Donald Trump reiterated to his Mexican counterpart, Claudia
Sheinbaum, that [the cartels “control
Mexico”](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2025/07/16/mundo/trump-advierte-
carteles-mexicanos-dominan-mexico-eu-debe-intervenir), and claimed, **without
presenting evidence, that the Mexican government does not have the capacity to
confront them** , during remarks to reporters this Thursday.

The president also warned that US forces will **intensify ground attacks
against the facilities of[drug
cartels](http://jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/03/14/politica/diputados-de-
morena-respaldan-a-sheinbaum-ante-declaraciones-de-trump-sobre-carteles) in
Latin America**:

> Oh, we haven’t even started. We haven’t yet deployed our full capacity on
> land. But this is already underway. We have to work; we are collaborating
> with Mexico… And, in reality, this is just beginning.
>
> Donald Trump

Trump added that the United States [knows all the routes used by the
cartels](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/09/22/mundo/trump-en-la-onu-
mexico-epicentro-de-la-violencia-de-los-carteles-debe-recuperar-el-control-de-
manos-de-los-enemigos-de-la-humanidad) and that “we are hitting them very
hard… But the pressure will increase. **They know they have a set deadline to,
basically, surrender** ,” Trump stated from the White House.
